// Every word the mod shows, in English and French. The pane, the status line,
// the toasts and the notes all read from the table `pick` returns.

export type Lang = 'en' | 'fr'

/** The actions that hold the pane busy; their label is shown while they run. */

files..claude-plugin/plugin.json:
{
  "name": "unity-watch",
  "version": "0.3.0",
  "description": "A live Unity pane for Claude Code: editor state, test runs with progress and history, builds, console errors and git, with one-click setup (Unity CLI, Pipeline package, editor install, Open Unity)",
  "author": {
    "name": "Théo Gégout",
    "url": "https://github.com/TheoGegout"
  },
  "homepage": "https://github.com/TheoGegout/claude-unity-watch",
  "repository": "https://github.com/TheoGegout/claude-unity-watch",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "claude-code",
    "claude-code-mod",
    "claude-code-plugin",
    "unity",
    "gamedev",
    "tests",
    "dashboard"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "language": {
      "title": "Language",
      "description": "Language of the pane, the status line and the toasts. auto follows your system's language",
      "type": "string",
      "options": [
        "auto",
        "en",
        "fr"
      ],
      "default": "auto"
    },
    "openOnStart": {
      "title": "Open on start",
      "description": "Open the pane when a session starts in a Unity project",
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": true
    },
    "statusLine": {
      "title": "Status line",
      "description": "Show the editor, tests, last build and console errors in the status line",
      "type": "boolean",
      "default": true
    },
    "testMode": {
      "title": "Test mode",
      "description": "Which suite the Run all tests button starts",
      "type": "string",
      "options": [
        "playmode",
        "editmode"
      ],
      "default": "playmode"
    },
    "buildTarget": {
      "title": "Build target",
      "description": "Platform the Build button builds to Builds/<project>.apk; off hides the button",
      "type": "string",
      "options": [
        "Android",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "Android"
    }
  }
}
